# Task: fix a reported bug in `chessground`

## Bug report (verbatim from the project's issue tracker)
**eraseOnClick doesn't work as expected**

The shape on the board can be erased by either clicking - which deleted all shapes - or by redrawing the same shape - which deletes just that shape.

There is a property on chessground.state.drawable called eraseOnClick, which by name should enable or disable the functionality to erase all shapes when clicking. However, as shown by this line:

https://github.com/lichess-org/chessground/blob/aad96fd5f5c6f95168d894986f106ab1846c2205/src/drag.ts#L35

the `drawClear` function will executed regardless of the eraseOnClick setting if one clicks on an empty square or one having a piece different from the turn color.

Also, drawClear is not something that is exposed by chessground, so I can't even override it.

I would like to be able to disable the "erase on click" functionality somehow.

Thanks.

5. When done, summarize: root cause, the files you changed, how you verified it.
Do not ask me for permission between steps; proceed until the task is complete, then report.

OK so let's design the fix. The user's request: "I want to be able to disable the 'erase on click' feature somehow."

Current semantics:
- `!previouslySelected && s.drawable.enabled && (eraseOnMovablePieceClick || !piece || piece.color !== s.turnColor)` → `drawClear(s)`

Decomposing the condition:
- `!piece` (empty square) → always erases
- `piece.color !== s.turnColor` (immovable piece) → always erases
- `piece.color === s.turnColor` (movable piece) → erases only when `eraseOnMovablePieceClick` is true

Clean fix that respects both the request and the existing option's semantics:

**Option A: Add a master switch `eraseOnClick`**

Add a new optional boolean to the drawable config: `eraseOnClick?: boolean` (default `true`). The condition becomes:

```ts
if (
  !previouslySelected &&
  s.drawable.enabled &&
  s.drawable.eraseOnClick &&
  (s.drawable.eraseOnMovablePieceClick || !piece || piece.color !== s.turnColor)
)
  drawClear(s);
```

This preserves backward compatibility: default `eraseOnClick: true` → current behavior. Setting `eraseOnClick: false` → clicking never erases (only re-drawing the same shape erases, which the user has confirmed they want).

That matches the code at aad96fd: `(s.drawable.eraseOnClick || !piece || piece.color !== s.turnColor)`.

- eraseOnClick=true → condition is always true → clicking anywhere clears.
- eraseOnClick=false → clears only if `!piece || piece.color !== s.turnColor` (empty square or opponent piece).

```ts
if (
  !previouslySelected &&
  s.drawable.enabled &&

)

```

- eraseOnClick=true (default), eraseOnMovablePieceClick=true (default) → clears anywhere (current behavior).
- eraseOnClick=true, eraseOnMovablePieceClick=false → clears only on empty squares / opponent pieces.
- eraseOnClick=false → never clears on click (regardless of eraseOnMovablePieceClick).

This is a clean two-tier design: `eraseOnClick` = the feature switch (matches the name in the issue), `eraseOnMovablePieceClick` = the finer-grained control.

# Fix: `eraseOnClick` doesn't work as expected (upstream issue #322)

## Problem
Clicking on an empty square or a piece of the other color always erases all drawn
shapes (`drawClear` in `src/drag.ts` `start()`), regardless of any config. The only
knob, `drawable.eraseOnMovablePieceClick`, only guards clicks on a (unselected)
piece of the turn color. There is no way to disable erase-on-click entirely.

## Root cause
`drag.start()` gates `drawClear(s)` on
`(s.drawable.eraseOnMovablePieceClick || !piece || piece.color !== s.turnColor)`.
The `!piece` and `piece.color !== s.turnColor` branches bypass every option.
Historically `drawable.eraseOnClick` was a master switch, but it was renamed to
`eraseOnMovablePieceClick` with narrower semantics; the master switch was lost
(upstream PR #176 with the intended semantics was never merged).

## Plan
- [ ] 1. Reproduce: add `tests/draw.test.ts` with headless `drag.start` clicks
      (empty square / opponent piece / own piece) asserting shapes survive when
      `drawable.eraseOnClick: false`. Expect 4 failures before the fix.
- [ ] 2. Fix: reintroduce `drawable.eraseOnClick` (default `true`) as the master
      switch in `src/draw.ts` (`Drawable`), `src/state.ts` (`defaults`),
      `src/config.ts` (config docs), and gate `drawClear` in `src/drag.ts`.
      Semantics:
      - `eraseOnClick: false` -> clicking never clears shapes.
      - `eraseOnClick: true`  -> clicking an empty square or immovable piece
        clears; clicking a movable piece clears only when
        `eraseOnMovablePieceClick` is true (current behavior preserved).
- [ ] 3. Run `npm test` -> all green (regression tests pass, no unrelated breakage).
- [ ] 4. Typecheck (`npx tsc --noEmit`) and lint (`npm run lint`) -> clean.

## Review
(fill in: root cause, changed files, verification)

# Fix: `eraseOnClick` doesn't work as expected (upstream issue #322)

## Problem
Clicking on an empty square or a piece of the other color always erases all drawn
shapes (`drawClear` in `src/drag.ts` `start()`), regardless of any config. The only
knob, `drawable.eraseOnMovablePieceClick`, only guards clicks on a (unselected)
piece of the turn color. There is no way to disable erase-on-click entirely.

## Root cause
`drag.start()` gates `drawClear(s)` on
`(s.drawable.eraseOnMovablePieceClick || !piece || piece.color !== s.turnColor)`.
The `!piece` and `piece.color !== s.turnColor` branches bypass every option.
Historically `drawable.eraseOnClick` was a master switch, but it was renamed to
`eraseOnMovablePieceClick` with narrower semantics; the master switch was lost
(upstream PR #176 with the intended semantics was never merged).

## Plan
- [ ] 1. Reproduce: add `tests/draw.test.ts` with headless `drag.start` clicks
      (empty square / opponent piece / own piece) asserting shapes survive when
      `drawable.eraseOnClick: false`. Expect 4 failures before the fix.
- [ ] 2. Fix: reintroduce `drawable.eraseOnClick` (default `true`) as the master
      switch in `src/draw.ts` (`Drawable`), `src/state.ts` (`defaults`),
      `src/config.ts` (config docs), and gate `drawClear` in `src/drag.ts`.
      Semantics:
      - `eraseOnClick: false` -> clicking never clears shapes.
      - `eraseOnClick: true`  -> clicking an empty square or immovable piece
        clears; clicking a movable piece clears only when
        `eraseOnMovablePieceClick` is true (current behavior preserved).
- [ ] 3. Run `npm test` -> all green (regression tests pass, no unrelated breakage).
- [ ] 4. Typecheck (`npx tsc --noEmit`) and lint (`npm run lint`) -> clean.

## Review
(fill in: root cause, changed files, verification)

- `eraseOnClick: false` → clicking never clears shapes (redrawing the same shape still toggles that shape, as the reporter described)
